uncited: **Linear Tree Array:** A contiguous array containing only leaf nodes.
Each element stores the spatial position (Morton code) and potentially a pointer or index to the data texture.
- Morton Code $M(x, y, z)$: Interleaves the bits of the 3D coordinates $x, y, z$ into a single integer.
Where $\text{interleave}$ maps the $i$-th bit of $x$, $y$, and $z$ to the $3i$-th, $3i+1$-th, and $3i+2$-th bits of the result, respectively.
- Tree depth: Determined by the resolution of the sparse space.
- **Time Complexity:** Building the linear array requires $O(N \log N)$ sorting, where $N$ is the number of leaves.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(N)$ for the linear array, plus $O(D)$ for the data texture, where $D$ is the number of unique data entries.
